summary.text: David Cannon is a Republican member of the West Virginia House of Delegates, representing District 89, and is seeking election to a full term in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Governor Jim Justice appointed him to the seat on January 13, 2025; he previously served as a Hampshire County commissioner.

paragraphs.text: David Cannon served as a county commissioner in Hampshire County, which includes the town of Romney, before his appointment to the House of Delegates.
Governor Jim Justice appointed Cannon to District 89 on January 13, 2025, to replace Darren Thorne.
Cannon advanced from the Republican primary on May 12, 2026.
